findings.desc: numeric-inconsistency: S17 states "~29-58 fixtures per group, both arms — roughly 84-116 paired fault-task runs total" but 2 fault-bearing groups x (29-58 fixtures each) in a matched-pairs design yields 58-116 total paired runs, not 84-116; the lower bound of 84 implies 42 fixtures per group, not 29; no arithmetic path from 29 per group to 84 total can be found

numeric-inconsistency: S7 planning table states reference N "~29-58 per arm" for the seeded controlled stratum (baseline 0.5-0.8, MDE 0.25-0.35), but a two-proportion z-test (alpha=0.05, power=0.80) across that full parameter band yields 25-59 per arm; the lower bound is 25, not 29 — verified by computing n at (baseline=0.5, MDE=0.35) = 25 and (baseline=0.55, MDE=0.35) = 27; only (baseline=0.5, MDE=0.33) or (baseline=0.55, MDE=0.34) yields n=29; the stated lower bound overstates required N at the most favorable parameter extreme by 14%

doc-promise-undelivered: M6 milestone (Reuses column) cites "Campaign runner (run-campaign.mjs identity-keyed resume)" as an existing reusable component, but experiments/recovery-runner/run-campaign.mjs does not exist in the repo (confirmed: ls experiments/recovery-runner/*.mjs lists no such file); the autopilot-v2 reliability plan (B-4e16, INIT) describes run-campaign.mjs as a to-be-built artifact under experiments/recovery-runner/powered/; citing a planned-but-unbuilt file as a reuse target is a factual error in the plan
